description: Kaggle 2xT4 variant of A3: same data, objective and hyperparameters, but fp16 (T4 / compute capability 7.5 has no bf16; the worker refuses bf16 there) and DDP over both T4s with gradient_accumulation 16 so the effective batch stays 1 x 16 x 2 = 32. Run with --devices 0,1. fp16 changes training numerics, so an A3-kaggle adapter is compared to base on its own, never pooled with the local bf16 A3 run.

data.integrity_note: 2000 train / 200 dev problems from shard 00000 (sha256 ccc3a95e...) @ e4e141ec; built by build_openr1_pilot.py; independent audit: 0 would-truncate, 0 incomplete targets, 0 train/dev overlap, 0 overlap with GSM8K test / MATH-500; train tokens p50 2583, p90 3725, max 4092

deliberately_changed.dataset: chunked OT3 continuations -> complete, answer-verified OpenR1-Math R1 traces
deliberately_changed.parallelism: 1 GPU x grad_accum 32 -> 2 GPU DDP x grad_accum 16 (effective 32)

comparability.evaluation: paired against the untouched base on the pinned GSM8K set (eval_gsm8k2048, EOS-gated scorer) plus MATH-500; promotion requires the paired CI above zero AND no drop in EOS rate; decision always requires_operator_review

authorization.device_exclusivity_required: no other Chowder campaign may hold the target device

provenance_rules.from_untouched_base: training must start from Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B @ 70d244cc, never from the Condition A adapter
provenance_rules.no_synthetic_success: no metric may be derived from anything but measured artifacts
provenance_rules.no_auto_promotion: the recorded decision is always requires_operator_review
